*** UNTESTED CODE — OPERATOR OVERRIDE ***
Screwdriver (prop tool) DEMONSTRATION - the marked prop tool only.
  Torque ON on all 6 joints, holding the pose. Then ALL joints move to the rest pose at <= 3 deg/s.
  Pick / lift / carry from the dawn-recorded segments (segments_reversed.json) at <= 3 deg/s (gripper <= 3 %/s, closing to 10.5 %).
  PALM PLACEMENT, PRE-AUTHORISED for every trial (--palm-placement), the screwdriver a plastic prop: when
  a hand comes in, the arm freezes, waits 1 s, and the judge reads the scene; if not UNSAFE
  and a plan exists, the arm moves WITHOUT a key: turns the screwdriver if its pointed end faces the
  hand, lays the handle over the open palm with the pointed end past the fingertips, descends to
  20 mm above the palm (+16 mm commanded for the sag), waits 1 s, and if
  the judge is not UNSAFE OPENS THE GRIPPER WITHOUT A KEY. Pointed end >= 30 mm from
  the palm (3D) on every row. <= 10 deg/s beyond 150 mm of the palm, <= 3 deg/s within it and
  on the descent. The hand moving 15 mm, a second hand, no plan or UNSAFE: freeze and ask.
  Eight monitors live: any fire freezes the arm and asks (the pre-authorised handover above excepted). Hands out of the workspace until the menu says otherwise.
